title: When a payment takes too many paths
excerpt: A representative scenario: how a payments platform with distributed logic and unowned data is mapped, and which services bring the flow into order.

children.text: This article describes a representative scenario. It does not describe work with a specific client, and the results it mentions are expected, not achieved.

A payments platform grows in layers: charging, fraud checks, reconciliation and accounting. When each layer decides on its own, the same transaction can have three different states. Finding the right one takes days.
